cards.text: Back in verses 1 to 13, the LORD sent Samuel to anoint a new king from among the sons of Jesse, a man with eight sons. Samuel anointed the youngest, David, and the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon him from that day forward. Now we head over to Saul, king of Israel, where something's about to shift, friend.

cards.question: Over with Saul, the Spirit of the LORD rushes upon him too. True or false?
The Spirit of the LORD departs from Saul, and a spirit of distress from the LORD begins to torment him. Who speaks up and tells Saul about it?

cards.text: His servants, and they've got a plan: Saul should command them to seek out someone with one special skill. Whenever the spirit of distress is upon him, that person uses it, and Saul will be well.

cards.question: What skill are Saul's servants looking for?
Saul hears his servants' plan to find a harp player and turns it down. True or false?

cards.text: Nope, Saul is ALL in: "Find me someone who plays well, and bring him to me." And one of the servants? He already knows a guy.

cards.question: Whose son does Saul's servant say knows how to play the harp?

answers.text: A son of Jesse of Bethlehem
A son of Eli of Shiloh
A son of Elkanah of Ramah

cards.text: Then the servant just keeps GOING: mighty man of valor, warrior, eloquent AND handsome. Friend, that's not a reference, that's a fan club.

cards.question: Last on the servant's list about Jesse's son: he says the ___ is with him.

cards.text: So Saul sends messengers to Jesse: "Send me your son David, who is with the sheep." The KING is calling, and David's out in a field. That's like the CEO ringing your phone while you're out mowing the lawn.

cards.question: Jesse doesn't send David to the king empty-handed. What does he send to Saul along with him?

answers.text: Bread and wine and a young goat
Gold and silver and fine robes
Oil and honey and a calf

cards.text: A donkey loaded with bread, a skin of wine and one young goat, plus one harp-playing son. David arrives and enters Saul's service.

cards.question: When David comes and enters his service, Saul loves him very much. True or false?
Besides the harp, Saul gives David another job. David becomes Saul's ___.

cards.text: From the sheep to the king's side, just like that. Then Saul sends word back to Jesse.

cards.question: What does Saul ask Jesse in his message?

answers.text: To let David stay in his service
To send his older sons as well
To come and live at the palace

cards.text: And Saul's reason: "for I am pleased with him." Friend, I spent YEARS in a junk drawer waiting for anybody to say that about me.

cards.question: Whenever the spirit from God comes upon Saul, David picks up his harp and plays. When he does, Saul's distress only gets worse. True or false?

cards.text: Saul finds relief, feels better, and the spirit of distress departs from him. That's where we'll leave it for now, friend, because this story is only just going into the oven.
